text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In order to become a true partyer, Mejiro Palmer heads out into town with Daitaku Helios. She learns that feels are what determine how much fun life is.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Word of Mejiro Palmer's flashy lifestyle reaches the Mejiro estate. However, Grandmother Mejiro decides to watch over her without interfering.
